item.title: Ent Credit Union to enter long-empty Longmont building
item.description: A large, long-vacant bank building in northwest Longmont soon will have a new tenant, with the arrival on its ground floor this spring of Colorado Springs-based Ent Credit Union.

item.title: Aclarion secures $10.4M for back-pain diagnostic technology
item.description: Aclarion Inc. (Nasdaq: ACON) recently raised $10.4 million through a stock sale, funding that extends the Broomfield-based health-care technology company’s operating runway into 2028, as it works to expand insurance coverage for its advanced imaging decision support tool for chronic back pain.

item.title: Renovated strip center to bring more restaurants to downtown Longmont
item.description: A building on the north end of downtown Longmont is being renovated and prepared for the arrival of two or three new restaurants and the relocation of a popular wine bar.

item.title: Colorado Buffs women’s basketball ready for challenge from No. 14 TCU
item.description: On Sunday, the Buffs face perhaps their biggest challenge on the Big 12 slate when No. 14-ranked TCU visits the CU Events Center.

item.description: The photo session fees for the March competition will be donated to Longmont nonprofit A Woman’s Work.

item.title: Myra Wherry helps lead Broomfield girls swimming to Granite Peaks League title
item.description: A mere seven months ago, Broomfield’s Myra Wherry wasn’t sure she’d be able to compete during her senior swimming season.

item.title: Sebastian Rancik’s first double-double leads Colorado past Arizona State
item.description: As a native of Slovakia, it’s not often Sebastian Rancik gets to play in front of his loved ones.

item.title: CSU Rams snap losing skid with win over San Jose State
item.description: FORT COLLINS — Colorado State snapped a three-game losing streak with a 65-57 victory over San Jose State on Saturday at Moby Arena. With the win, the Rams improved to 13-10 overall and 4-8 in the Mountain West Conference. They had lost eight of their previous 11 games prior to Saturday’s win over the Spartans.
